title: FA/116/2014 of Ashwini Kumar AND ANOTHER Vs Vijay Sharma AND OTHERS

paras.text:
FA 116/2014
oníble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.H
Mr. Nikhil Singhal, Advocate, for
the appellants.
The litigation was persisting among
five real brothers and, now, at this stage
they arrived at family settlement. So,
learned Counsel wants to withdraw this
first appeal.
Hence, withdrawal application
(CLMA 2467/2015) is hereby allowed.
This first appeal is dismissed as
withdrawn.
LCR, if summoned, be sent back.
